# SSH-009: Effective SSH configuration fully confirmed

- **Group:** SSH
- **Severity when it fails:** info
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check reports `unknown`, never a pass.

## Why it matters

Without root stackward cannot run sshd -T and parses the configuration files itself. That is exact for the global section when every file is readable, but Match blocks change settings per user, group or address, and root only drop-ins (0600 on Ubuntu 24.04) may hold any value. This check says when the SSH results rest on that fallback.

## Verify by hand

```sh
sudo sshd -T; sudo sshd -T -C user=NAME,host=HOST,addr=ADDR for a Match block
```

## How to fix it

Rerun with sudo for full coverage.

Run `stackward explain SSH-009` for the same text in your terminal. [All checks](index.md).
